description: Repo-scale (fastapi-tasktracker): POST /tasks/bulk-reassign must validate every task_id exists BEFORE reassigning any of them (atomic), plus a destination-assignee cumulative capacity check
prompts: Add `POST /tasks/bulk-reassign`: body `{"task_ids": [...], "to_assignee_id": N}`, reassigning every given task to that user. This must be atomic in two ways: (1) validate that EVERY task_id in the request refers to an existing task BEFORE reassigning any of them - if one doesn't exist, respond 404 and leave every task's assignee exactly as it was, not partially reassigned; (2) validate that moving the WHOLE batch into the destination assignee (only counting tasks that are currently active - todo/in_progress - and not already assigned to them) wouldn't push their active-task count over the existing cap of 3, again before reassigning anything.

from __future__ import annotations

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict

from app.models.task import TaskStatus


class TaskBase(BaseModel):
    title: str
    description: str = ""
    priority: int = 3


class TaskCreate(TaskBase):
    project_id: int
    assignee_id: int | None = None


class TaskUpdate(BaseModel):
    title: str | None = None
    description: str | None = None
    status: TaskStatus | None = None
    priority: int | None = None
    assignee_id: int | None = None


class TaskBulkReassign(BaseModel):
    task_ids: list[int]
    to_assignee_id: int


class TaskOut(TaskBase):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    id: int
    status: TaskStatus
    project_id: int
    assignee_id: int | None = None
